method: Production bundle in JSDOM: independent batch cards, direct stock form, batch-specific quantities and dates, filters, metadata save and correction; no browser layout engine
checks: single card has one quantity and opens the stock form directly
expired stock remains in physical total
two batches have separate quantities, dates and edit targets
location filter retains only matching batch card
search ignores case and supports empty results
unknown date and absent location have clear labels
zero stock does not receive expired-stock alert
each batch retains its own unit and quantity
metadata edit saves intended location and retains stock
stock correction remains accessible from expanded card
category inventory also uses compact cards
inventory navigation preserves recipe availability and stored data
